PortScan.description: Horizontal scanning of the network for reachable devices and open service ports.

C&C.description: Periodic beaconing to a command-and-control server over a common application protocol.

DDoS.description: High-volume flooding of a target, degrading or stopping its service.

Attack.description: Active intrusion attempts against remote services (e.g. Telnet/SSH login attempts or exploits).

FileDownload.description: Retrieval of additional payloads or tools from a remote server.

Okiru.description: Okiru (Mirai-variant) botnet propagation: scanning and Telnet brute force against IoT devices.
